description: Search and list campaigns and drafts in the WordFlux Content Library by keyword, platform, brand, status, date window (e.g. today, yesterday, last_2_days, last_7_days, days: 2), or Auto-Scheduler source (autoSchedulerOnly: true or source: "auto_scheduler").

autoSchedulerOnly.description: Set true to return only campaigns generated automatically by Auto-Scheduler / Content Radar

date.description: Optional date preset (today | yesterday | last_2_days | last_3_days | last_7_days | this_week, or YYYY-MM-DD)

days.description: Optional trailing day count (1-90), e.g. 2 for campaigns generated in the last 2 days

platform.description: Optional platform filter (e.g. linkedin, instagram, x, threads, blog)

search.description: Keyword search across campaign titles and platform asset body copy

sortBy.description: Sort order ("createdAt" or "updatedAt"; defaults to "createdAt" when filtering by date or autoSchedulerOnly)

source.description: Optional source filter (all | auto_scheduler | auto_generated | manual, or exact source like RADAR_AUTO)

status.description: Optional status filter (DRAFT, PENDING_TEAM_APPROVAL, TEAM_APPROVED, CLIENT_APPROVED, COMPLETED)

name: wordflux_list_content
